g.text: Architecture changes the cost of retaining more bins
Left: 16 microphones / N128. Right: FFT, 16 microphones / N64 / all seven in-band bins.
FFT storage remains a full frame even when fewer bins enter DAS. DFT storage grows with selected-bin count.
FFT storage is 18/Q16; DFT raw accumulator is 32/Q24; both deliver 24/Q22 spectra. Rounding differs. Lines are guides/estimates, dots are measurements.
